title: SecurityException
description: Schema for auditable, expiring security scanner exceptions in the Home PVE pipeline.

id.description: Rule or vulnerability identifier (e.g. CKV2_ANSIBLE_1, CVE-2026-1234, trivy-rule-id).

tool.description: Security scanner or linter that surfaced the finding.

owner.description: Maintainer handle responsible for the exception and its remediation.

approved_by.description: Repository approver who authorized the exception.

expires_at.description: Hard expiration date for the exception (YYYY-MM-DD).

path.description: Repo-relative path to the affected file. Must not be a root or wildcard glob.

resource.description: Optional specific resource identifier, task name, or stanza within the file.

rationale.description: Technical justification explaining why the finding cannot be immediately resolved.

remediation_ticket.description: Tracking milestone, issue, or roadmap phase that will remediate the underlying debt.
